method: Descriptions, header correction and study comments only. Type 1-5, STEP, ROTSTEP and other operational records are unchanged.

sections.title: Ferrari F40 complete car
sections.lesson: Low sports-car body with sideways panels, opening-panel joints, a detailed rear engine and a Technic frame. The 73 saved callouts are not referenced by this flattened main model.

sections.title: Front wheel axle and hub stack
sections.lesson: Axles, liftarms and round hub faces establish a wheel mounting assembly; inspect its supports in the chassis.

sections.title: Side sill hinge shafts
sections.lesson: Two transverse axles carry locking hinge arms; keep joint interfaces separate from their decorative sill covering.

sections.title: Rear transverse pin and axle frame
sections.lesson: Cross blocks and stopped pins form a compact mounting frame behind the cabin.

sections.title: Long chassis side rail
sections.lesson: Technic bricks overlap through pins to establish a long frame member. Saved colours differ from the main model.

sections.title: Rear axle pin block
sections.lesson: A thick rectangular Technic member distributes four pin attachments.

sections.title: Bracket and side-stud body mount A
sections.lesson: Combine a 99206 bracket, 87087 side-stud brick and a clip in a five-piece body mount. The main model uses a different clip variant.

sections.title: Bracket and side-stud body mount B
sections.lesson: The opposing mount changes the clip position without mirroring a physical part.

sections.title: Tiled sill strip A
sections.lesson: A long tiled strip conceals repeated hinge bases along the lower side of the car.

sections.title: Tiled sill strip B
sections.lesson: Opposing sill trim retains the same narrow tiled surface and repeated hinge spacing.

sections.title: Curved front arch end cap
sections.lesson: A small curved slope finishes a brick-and-plate stack; inspect its rotated placement at the arch end.

sections.title: Front bulkhead and dashboard support
sections.lesson: A Technic crossbar carries brackets, handles and two sideways pin blocks, separating structural span from attachment faces.

sections.title: Bracket-mounted pin block
sections.lesson: A 99207 bracket turns the stud grid for a pin-bearing block; two instances belong to the saved bulkhead.

sections.title: Stacked door hinge clips
sections.lesson: Clip plates at two heights form a compact hinge-side mounting stack.

sections.title: Cabin lever and bar fitting
sections.lesson: Small bar and clip fittings suggest a cabin control; their appearance does not establish a working mechanism.

sections.title: Curved cabin trim with handle
sections.lesson: A curved slope covers a short plate stack while leaving its handle available as an interface.

sections.title: Steering wheel and gauge cluster
sections.lesson: A compact angled steering assembly combines a curved dashboard cover, gauges and Technic supports.

sections.title: Passenger dashboard and sideways fascia
sections.lesson: Headlight bricks create a recessed sideways tile mounting plane within a long dashboard.

sections.title: Dashboard corner cap
sections.lesson: A three-piece corner support receives a curved cap to soften the dashboard end.

sections.title: Front bay arch brace
sections.lesson: Arch and slope parts leave a clear opening inside a compact frame.

sections.title: Rear quarter lower core A
sections.lesson: A plate-built corner combines a vertical red panel, curved trim and a projecting wedge support.

sections.title: Rear quarter wedge tab A
sections.lesson: A wedge plate widens a small support asymmetrically; inspect the parent for its exposed edge.

sections.title: Rear quarter lower core B
sections.lesson: The opposite rear corner changes its plate layout rather than reflecting part geometry.

sections.title: Rear quarter wedge tab B
sections.lesson: The opposite wedge tab supplies the other side of the rear quarter support.

sections.title: Rear cabin crossbar and pillar mounts
sections.lesson: Side-stud bricks carry two smaller pillar supports off the ends of a crossbar.

sections.title: Sideways pillar support
sections.lesson: A narrow upright support becomes a sideways cabin fitting when placed by its parent.

sections.title: Reclining seat cushion and headrest
sections.lesson: Clip-and-bar joints separate the seat cushion and headrest angles; the whole seat has its own cabin pose.

sections.title: Clipped seat headrest
sections.lesson: A wedge tile finishes a small clip-mounted headrest independently of the cushion.

sections.title: Twin seat frames and cabin rear wall
sections.lesson: Repeated Technic seat frames sit behind separate cushions, with a plate-and-brick wall closing the cabin.

sections.title: Technic seat frame
sections.lesson: Bent liftarms establish an L-shaped seat support; two instances share this construction.

sections.title: Seat back infill
sections.lesson: A narrow brick stack fills a seat frame while retaining pin-hole connections.

sections.title: Windscreen and cowl alternative
sections.lesson: This saved callout builds glazing from multiple parts; the finished car instead uses a dedicated printed windscreen. Do not substitute the two by count or title alone.

sections.title: Windscreen cowl spacer
sections.lesson: An inverted curved slope shapes the lower transition under the saved windscreen.

sections.title: Side intake behind door A
sections.lesson: A bracket and layered plates shape a small recessed intake with a sloping outer edge.

sections.title: Door with sideways inner panel A
sections.lesson: Brackets support a thin inner door surface while stacked clips remain exposed along the hinge edge.

sections.title: Door upper bracket strip A
sections.lesson: Three 44728 brackets turn a narrow tiled rail into a repeated sideways stud face.

sections.title: Side intake behind door B
sections.lesson: The opposing intake uses its own plate and slope arrangement to retain the recessed contour.

sections.title: Door with sideways inner panel B
sections.lesson: The opposite door combines its own bracket strip, hinge clips and layered outer surface.

sections.title: Door upper bracket strip B
sections.lesson: A companion bracket rail belongs to the opposite door, despite similar parts appearing on both sides.

sections.title: Side mirror housing
sections.lesson: A rounded plate and curved slope form a tiny mirror housing around a side attachment.

sections.title: Detailed engine and triple exhaust
sections.lesson: A static engine display combines angled cylinder-bank shapes, side-stud fittings, ribs, rounded housings and three exhaust outlets.

sections.title: Triple exhaust outlet
sections.lesson: Three cylindrical sleeves around pin supports form a compact exhaust cluster.

sections.title: Angled engine cylinder-bank display
sections.lesson: Angled Technic supports carry two detailed banks. Four rounded source rotations need the existing bounded normalization when preparing this study.

sections.title: Engine bank with repeated fittings
sections.lesson: A side-stud brick and rail plates support four repeated cylindrical details; this is visual engine detailing, not piston simulation.

sections.title: Engine bracket and jumper pedestal
sections.lesson: A bracket turns a small plate stack toward a perpendicular face while a jumper centres the next fitting.

sections.title: Headlight-brick round engine fitting
sections.lesson: A headlight brick receives a stack of round plates on its side to suggest a compact cylindrical fitting.

sections.title: Twin cylindrical engine fitting
sections.lesson: Two round columns share a short plate, allowing a repeated detail to be handled as one module.

sections.title: Ribbed engine side detail
sections.lesson: A grille-like ribbed brick is capped and attached through a bar-bearing plate.

sections.title: Layered curved engine housing
sections.lesson: Brackets and headlight bricks combine top and side layers into a rounded housing with small inclined fittings.

sections.title: Curved housing side cap
sections.lesson: A headlight brick and bracket support a curved cap within the larger engine housing.

sections.title: Rear lower bumper frame
sections.lesson: A wide, thin frame leaves a central exhaust opening and joins stepped bumper corners.

sections.title: Rear cross-body bar fitting
sections.lesson: A long bar and handle connect across the rear area; inspect its receiving clips and clearances in context.

sections.title: Rear clamshell with lamps and louvered window
sections.lesson: A large body module combines perpendicular rear lighting, quarter frames, an upper edge and repeated window louvers.

sections.title: Rear corner lamp and side grille
sections.lesson: A bracket joins two perpendicular visible faces: a dish lamp and a pair of grille tiles.

sections.title: Rear quarter frame and glazing A
sections.lesson: Layered rails and wedge glazing frame one side of the rear clamshell; check the parent for its inclination.

sections.title: Rear quarter frame and glazing B
sections.lesson: The companion quarter frame uses a separate source construction for the other side.

sections.title: Rear clamshell upper bridge
sections.lesson: Broad plates, partial stud fields and opposing wedges bridge the top of the clamshell.

sections.title: Repeated rear-window louver
sections.lesson: Side-stud bricks connect translucent panel faces to a narrow rail. Three instances form the stepped rear-window louvers.

sections.title: Rear-window louver end transition
sections.lesson: Different side-stud bricks terminate the repeated louver pattern and connect its end trim.

sections.title: Rear wing support A
sections.lesson: A thin tiled member and handle/clip fitting build a narrow support beside the rear deck.

sections.title: Rear wing support B
sections.lesson: The opposite wing support retains the same narrow surface while changing its attachment end.

sections.title: Rear wing top span
sections.lesson: A simple plate-and-tile strip provides the full-width spoiler silhouette; its uprights belong to the surrounding car.

sections.title: Front bumper lower corner A
sections.lesson: Wedge plates and tiles define one lower bumper corner around a Technic attachment.

sections.title: Front fascia perpendicular mounting core
sections.lesson: Two 99207 brackets provide a sideways stud field beside Technic hole bricks, keeping the fascia mounting core separate from its skin.

sections.title: Front bumper lower corner B
sections.lesson: The companion bumper support combines a bracket, Technic hole and layered corner plates.

sections.title: Small curved front lamp trim
sections.lesson: A curved slope and short stack of coloured or transparent plates suggest a compact lamp edge.

sections.title: Front bay edge rail
sections.lesson: A narrow stepped plate rail locates the edge of the front compartment.

sections.title: Clipped front lamp glazing
sections.lesson: A clip plate supports a transparent panel at an angle. The main car uses different clip and panel variants.

sections.title: Angled front lamp cover A
sections.lesson: Offset pin-hole plates carry a sloping cover around a pin axis. Rounded source matrices require bounded normalization for the study.

sections.title: Angled front lamp cover B
sections.lesson: The opposing cover has its own angled assembly; preserve the pivot and do not mirror the parts.

sections.title: Front fender curved cap A
sections.lesson: Two related curved slopes form a broad fender contour on a narrow plate support.

sections.title: Front fender curved cap B
sections.lesson: The opposing fender cap continues the same slope family and layered support.

sections.title: Bonnet with recessed vents and curved nose
sections.lesson: A broad tiled panel combines curved leading edges, sideways inset vent details and a separate hinge-bar module.

sections.title: Bonnet hinge bar and bracket
sections.lesson: Clips retain a transverse bar on a bracket-supported plate stack; the parent supplies the bonnet pose and receiving supports.
